Based on the provided financial disclosures and earnings reports, here is the detailed GAAP performance for Microsoft across the eight requested fiscal quarters:

**1. Quarter Ended December 31, 2024 (FY25 Q2)**
Microsoft reported strong cloud-driven growth for this period. GAAP revenue reached $69.6 billion, marking a 12% year-over-year increase [[23]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/earnings/fy-2025-q2/press-release-webcast), [[25]](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/PressReleaseFY25Q2). GAAP net income stood at $24.1 billion, reflecting a 10% increase from the prior year [[25]](https://cdn-dynmedia-1.microsoft.com/is/content/microsoftcorp/PressReleaseFY25Q2), [[28]](https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:c1b5646b9428c:0-microsoft-q2-2025-financial-results/). Diluted earnings per share (EPS) were reported at $3.23, also up 10% year-over-year [[28]](https://www.tradingview.com/news/tradingview:c1b5646b9428c:0-microsoft-q2-2025-financial-results/).

**2. Quarter Ended March 31, 2025 (FY25 Q3)**
Continuing its momentum, Microsoft's GAAP revenue climbed to $70.1 billion, representing a 13% year-over-year growth [[15]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2025-Q3/press-release-webcast), [[97]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2025-Q3/press-release-webcast). GAAP net income rose 18% to $25.8 billion [[18]](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/04/30/microsoft-msft-q3-earnings-report-2025.html). Diluted EPS increased by 18% to $3.46, comfortably surpassing analyst consensus estimates [[99]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2025/04/30/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-drives-third-quarter-results-2/), [[102]](https://equitytldr.substack.com/p/microsoft-fy2025-q3-riding-the-ai).

**3. Quarter Ended June 30, 2025 (FY25 Q4)**
Closing out fiscal year 2025, the company posted GAAP revenue of $76.4 billion, an 18% increase year-over-year [[6]](https://www.techpowerup.com/339430/microsoft-releases-fy25-q4-earnings-report), [[73]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/investor/earnings/fy-2025-q4/press-release-webcast). GAAP net income reached $27.2 billion, up 24% from the prior year period [[75]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2025/07/30/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-fuels-fourth-quarter-results/), [[79]](https://www.techpowerup.com/339430/microsoft-releases-fy25-q4-earnings-report). Diluted EPS grew 24% to $3.65 [[75]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2025/07/30/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-fuels-fourth-quarter-results/), [[79]](https://www.techpowerup.com/339430/microsoft-releases-fy25-q4-earnings-report).

**4. Quarter Ended September 30, 2025 (FY26 Q1)**
Microsoft started fiscal year 2026 with GAAP revenue of $77.67 billion, driven by an 18% year-over-year increase and a 40% surge in Azure cloud sales [[13]](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2025-10-29-microsoft-co-stock/), [[94]](https://www.techpowerup.com/342404/microsoft-releases-fy26-q1-earnings-report). GAAP net income was $27.7 billion, up 12% year-over-year [[93]](https://www.neowin.net/news/microsoft-posts-277-billion-profit-in-q1-fy2026/), [[95]](https://english.news.cn/20251030/eb6c210714414422a1ccf4b0838c6d12/c.html). Diluted EPS came in at $4.13, though this figure was negatively impacted by a $3.1 billion net loss from OpenAI investments, which reduced EPS by $0.41 [[10]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/10/28/microsoft-announces-first-quarter-results-2/), [[13]](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2025-10-29-microsoft-co-stock/).

**5. Quarter Ended December 31, 2025 (FY26 Q2)**
Revenue accelerated to $81.3 billion, a 17% year-over-year increase [[24]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/01/28/microsoft-cloud-and-ai-strength-drives-second-quarter-results-3/), [[63]](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MSFT/10-q-microsoft-corp-quarterly-earnings-report-b6f537ec392a.html). GAAP net income jumped significantly to $38.5 billion, reflecting robust scale benefits in high-margin cloud services [[63]](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MSFT/10-q-microsoft-corp-quarterly-earnings-report-b6f537ec392a.html), [[69]](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MSFT/10-q-microsoft-corp-quarterly-earnings-report-b6f537ec392a.html). Diluted EPS rose to $5.16, with a minor $0.12 per-share reduction attributed to OpenAI investment losses [[66]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q2/press-release-webcast), [[69]](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/MSFT/10-q-microsoft-corp-quarterly-earnings-report-b6f537ec392a.html).

**6. Quarter Ended March 31, 2026 (FY26 Q3)**
Microsoft reported GAAP revenue of $82.9 billion, maintaining an 18% year-over-year growth trajectory [[38]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q3/press-release-webcast), [[65]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q3/press-release-webcast). GAAP net income was $31.78 billion, up 23% from the prior year [[44]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/29/microsoft-msft-q3-earnings-report-2026.html), [[65]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q3/press-release-webcast). Diluted EPS increased 23% to $4.27 [[44]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/04/29/microsoft-msft-q3-earnings-report-2026.html), [[65]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q3/press-release-webcast).

**7. Quarter Ended June 30, 2026 (FY26 Q4)**
The company closed fiscal year 2026 with record GAAP revenue of $90.0 billion, an 18% increase year-over-year, as Azure cloud revenue surpassed $100 billion annually for the first time [[35]](https://www.techpowerup.com/351206/microsoft-announces-fourth-quarter-fiscal-year-2026-results), [[36]](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/articles/microsoft-q4-2026-earnings-azure-111058880.html?fr=sycsrp%5Fcatchall). GAAP net income reached $35.77 billion, up 31% [[32]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-msft-q4-earnings-report-2026.html), [[80]](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q4/press-release-webcast). Diluted EPS climbed 32% to $4.81, partially boosted by a $3.2 billion unrealized gain on its Anthropic investment [[32]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-msft-q4-earnings-report-2026.html), [[34]](https://www.theregister.com/software/2026/07/30/microsoft-earnings-q4-26-cloud-brings-revenue-rain/5280798).

**8. Quarter Ended September 30, 2026 (FY27 Q1)**
Microsoft kicked off fiscal year 2027 with GAAP revenue of $92.3 billion, a 19% year-over-year increase driven by 48% Azure growth [[50]](https://stockmarkethours.org/events/microsoft-earnings), [[52]](https://www.cashandchaos.com/guides/microsoft-q1-2027-earnings-azure-capex-free-cash-flow). GAAP net income was $36,629 million ($36.6 billion), representing a 32% rise [[88]](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/microsoft-posts-32-rise-q1-082820492.html?fr=sycsrp%5Fcatchall), [[159]](https://gameindustrylibrary.com/documents/microsoft-10-q-q1-fy2027-october-2026). Diluted EPS reached $4.92, up 32% year-over-year, and included a $207 million net gain from OpenAI investments that added $0.03 to EPS [[112]](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/28/microsoft-msft-q1-earnings-report-2027.html), [[159]](https://gameindustrylibrary.com/documents/microsoft-10-q-q1-fy2027-october-2026), [[190]](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/10/28/microsoft-announces-first-quarter-results-2/).
